cabot-trail-highlands-loop-part-3.title: Cabot Trail Highlands Loop · part 3
cabot-trail-highlands-loop-part-3.slogan: back through Pleasant Bay to Baddeck · one way, about 230 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Pleasant Bay
waypoints.advice: Pleasant Bay is where the day begins. Next is Cape Smokey, climbing 346 m.

waypoints.name: Cape Smokey
waypoints.advice: Cape Smokey comes up 33 km in. The road climbs 346 m over at least 40 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 2 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Ingonish, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Ingonish
waypoints.advice: 66 km in you reach Ingonish. You lose 356 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is back through Cape Smokey, climbing 356 m.

waypoints.name: back through Cape Smokey
waypoints.advice: back through Cape Smokey, about halfway at 366 m. The road climbs 356 m on the way up to it, steadily. Next is back through Pleasant Bay, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: back through Pleasant Bay
waypoints.advice: back through Pleasant Bay sits at 131 km, about halfway. You lose 346 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is back through French Mountain, climbing 435 m.

waypoints.name: back through French Mountain
waypoints.advice: back through French Mountain comes up 164 km in. The road climbs 435 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is back through Chéticamp, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: back through Chéticamp
waypoints.advice: 197 km in you reach back through Chéticamp. You lose 445 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Baddeck.

waypoints.name: Baddeck
waypoints.advice: Back at Baddeck. That is the ride.

sections.advice: Pleasant Bay → Cape Smokey is 50 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Cape Smokey → Ingonish is 7 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Ingonish → back through Cape Smokey is 7 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through Cape Smokey → back through Pleasant Bay is 50 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through Pleasant Bay → back through French Mountain climbs about 435 m in 13 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
back through French Mountain → back through Chéticamp drops about 445 m over 23 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
back through Chéticamp → Baddeck is 78 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Cabot Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: For 7 km this is Cabot Trail, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Cabot Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 13 km. 435 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: back through French Mountain → back through Chéticamp
scenicChapters.narrative: 23 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

cabot-trail-highlands-loop-part-3.story: It goes by way of Cape Smokey, Ingonish, back through Cape Smokey and back through Pleasant Bay.
